  Doc: DocComment "Sovereign's telemetry catalogue: every event type the game servers emit, the lake table\nthat stores it, its columns and their version history, the ring tier and producers, and\nwhat its rows mean to the economy ledgers. Today this is spread over X-macros\n(TELEMETRY_META_*, TELEMETRY_FIELDS_*, TELEMETRY_LEDGER_*), hand-kept enum blocks, a\nschema lock that alone knows the history, and a Python generator that parses the C++.\n\nHere it is one package (ADR L-0111 d.1). The C++ packer and the ring set read the\nper-event metadata at compile time (header-inline constexpr lookups, DECISIONS 293);\nmonitoring reads the same facts from Go; the lake's DDL, its enum views and a JSON\ncatalogue are build-time strings written by `emit text` (DECISIONS 294).\n\nThis dry run carries 7 of the 86 tables, the two tombstoned event ids, and a trimmed\nGrantKind (14 of its 62 members, the retired ones kept)." @1:1-13:61
